searches.note: Twenty six searches of a share of twenty eight, none of them the author's; two left unspent. Eleven were restricted to a house's own domain and are read as primary through their summaries: gianfrancofino.it twice (the Es sheets; Gf, Jo and Sé), rivera.it three times (the family page; the Il Falcone sheets; the name and the maceration), leonedecastris.com twice (the history; the Five Roses sheets), taurinovini.it twice (the origins; the Patriglione and vineyard pages) and cantinepolvanera.it twice (the manor and cellar; the 17, the 21 and the Minutolo). Seven more blocked the author's own sources so that a second, independent source would show: the house and Superiore.de for Gianfranco Fino twice, the house and Superiore.de for Five Roses, Skurnik for Patriglione twice, the house for Rivera and for Polvanera 16. Two went to the appellations (the Primitivo di Manduria and Castel del Monte texts at AIS) and two to the indications (Salento IGT; Gioia del Colle and Indellicati). One WebFetch was tried, the Il Falcone 2018 sheet on rivera.it, and refused (the host does not resolve here); no other fetch was tried. Every record was tested; no fact that rests on no source was kept in a record marked checked.

method: Each record was read with one instruction, refute it: the founding year, the people and their dates, the classification and its year, the grapes, the sites, the making and its months, the drinking window, the serving temperature, the label words, every beat of the story, the cards and the questions; then the house rules (nobody living named, no price, no score, nothing volatile, no judging superlative, no bare family word, British spelling, no dash).

The searches went first to the houses' own pages and sheets for their own dates and methods and to the appellations' texts, then to the press and the merchants, with the author's sources blocked where they would only have repeated themselves, for the second source of each date, person and place.

Where a detail rested on no source the refuter read (the end of October for Patriglione, the great wager, the vines saved from grubbing up, the month in bottle for Five Roses, older vines for the Anniversario, the founder's son's trials of the 1970s) it was cut or set as the sources give it; where the sources corrected the record (the serving temperature of Five Roses, the Malvasia Nera of older Patriglione, the name of Five Roses, the soils behind Polvanera's name, the Minutolo's indication) the record was set right with its source.

Prices, marks and scores met in the results (merchants' prices, a 92 of Robert Parker reprinted by Rivera, guides' glasses and stars, a 98 of Doctor Wine) were read and not used; hectares (18 or 23 for Gianfranco Fino, 150 for Rivera) were left out.

tested: Founded 2004 and the first Es from that year: Wine Spectator (in 2004 he struck out with a small holding of Primitivo and made the first bottles of Es) and the house's pages: confirmed. The library's 2004 holds.

The founder's olive growing before wine: Civiltà del bere and Seminario Veronelli in the results (an agronomist who long worked in olive growing): confirmed as written; the founder and his wife are living and unnamed.
The name: Wine Spectator (Es, the German term for Freud's id), Food and Travel and the house's sheet (Es according to Freud): confirmed.

Salento IGT and the early DOC: the house's sheet classes Es Salento Primitivo IGT and Caratello lists both Es Primitivo di Manduria DOC and Es Primitivo Salento IGT 2022: confirmed as early and later vintages.

The Primitivo di Manduria DOC of 1974 (DPR of 30 October 1974) and the Dolce Naturale DOCG (DM of 23 February 2011), in the AIS copy of the DOCG's text: confirmed. Salento IGT across the provinces of Brindisi, Lecce and Taranto: Italian Wine Central and another reference: confirmed.

The making: the English sheet (two to three weeks in steel tanks of 70 hectolitres, about nine months in oak, six in bottle) and the house's editorial of 2022 (maturation in barrique): corrected. The others: Gf a traditional method rosé of Negroamaro, Jo a Salento IGT Negroamaro, Sé a Salento IGT Primitivo, on the house's pages: confirmed.

The house rules: no living person named in prose (the house keeps its name), no price, no score (the guides' marks on the sheet read and not used), nothing volatile (hectares left out), no judging superlative, British, no dash. The cards and questions: the IGT question has one key and four readings of a label, its explanation teaches the dry Primitivo against the sweet DOCG; the year question's 1974 is the DOC, the plausible near miss, and is explained.

swapNote: The author proposed no swap, and the refuter proposes none. Polvanera, the thin pick, stands: a real house of the Gioia del Colle DOC that makes the wine, whose cellar, manor, founder, vineyards and making now rest on its own pages and two merchants, and which the region record already names; no source calls the 16 its flagship, and the record treats it as the wine the house is known by. planNotes: gianfranco-fino: the why calls Es the Primitivo di Manduria; its later vintages are Salento IGT (the house's sheet, Caratello) and its early ones Primitivo di Manduria DOC, so the why wants a word for the read-together agent. The note is answered: the house is named and the founder never in prose.

rivera: the note is answered: the seat at Andria (the house's pages) and the label Il Falcone Rosso Castel del Monte Riserva DOCG for vintages since 2011 (Superiore.de's 2019 listing, the house's sheets), a Riserva of the Castel del Monte DOC before. The why's house of 1950 holds as the library's year beside the house's late 1940s.

leone-de-castris: the note is answered: 1665 and 1943 are the house's own dates, with the Drinks Business and merchants beside them, and the first bottled rosato is hedged as the house's claim throughout.

taurino: the note is answered: the first Patriglione is the 1975 (the house's page, the Veronelli reprint) and Cosimo Taurino keeps his death of 1999 alone. The why's began as a forgotten cask of the 1970s rests on Skurnik alone and is not in the record; the read-together agent may set the why right.
